description.value: Color is trade language. A specific shade of blue marks a guild, a red signals rank, a particular combination of colors identifies a house. You learned to produce those colors reliably from plant, mineral, and animal sources, which meant you also learned what those colors meant to the people who wore them. You moved through workshops and markets and occasionally noble dye-houses, always present at the margins of more consequential conversations.

system.skillBonuses: Craft: Tailor 3, Society 3, Wilderness 3, Perception 3, +56 XP

system.features: Color Codes: You read guild liveries, house colors, and rank markers the way others read words. In a crowd, at court, or along a road, you can identify guild membership, noble house affiliation, military rank, and regional origin from clothing and banners. This same knowledge grants you easy entry into dye-houses, textile workshops, and guild supply chains as a recognized trade supplier.
